objective: Promote the exact accepted and locally conformant hosted KEP image to the existing isolated public Solana Devnet deployment while preserving its database volume, old image, protected environment, and rollback material.

allowed_effects_in_order: fail closed unless the current-state guard is still exact
create one mode-0600 PostgreSQL custom-format predeployment dump on the same VPS without changing database contents
upload the exact image archive to the exact staged archive path
upload the exact accepted compose bytes to compose.yaml.next
copy the protected current environment to .env.next and replace only its KEP_IMAGE value with the exact accepted image tag
load the exact staged archive once and verify the exact loaded image ID and tag
copy current compose.yaml and .env to the exact rollback paths while preserving .env mode 0600
atomically promote compose.yaml.next and .env.next to their active names
run docker compose up -d --no-build once for only the kep-hosted-devnet project
perform bounded container-health, public HTTPS, root-byte, TLS, and Solana-Devnet identity reads
preserved_state: rollback compose and protected environment copies
unrelated VPS containers, networks, volumes, files, and routes
stop_conditions: any upload, archive, image-load, staging, promotion, activation, health, HTTPS, TLS, network, or root-byte failure
execution_envelope.retry_policy: none; stop and report the exact observed residue after the first effectful failure or ambiguity
forbidden_effects: Mainnet or any network other than public Solana Devnet
printing, exporting, replacing, or reusing the database password or any credential
source rebuild or substitution of archive, image, Compose, target, route, or RPC
database restore, data deletion, volume removal, image pruning, or destructive migration
mutation of unrelated VPS services or files
automatic rollback or retry after a failed or ambiguous effect
publication, release, Git commit, or Git push

backup_posture.claim_limit: This deployment envelope provides same-VPS predeployment residue and preserves the live volume; it does not claim three-layer backup completion or restore verification.

claim_limit: Candidate for one exact prebuilt-image promotion to the named existing Solana Devnet VPS. It does not authorize itself, credentials, SSH writes, upload, image load, activation, rollback, retry, transaction submission, publication, release, or any external effect.
